name: Seraph's Kiss
source:
Winchester, 1906. Arabella Ravencroft is dead, and nine suspects are trapped inside a mansion. You are Inspector Hartwell. Combine clues to forge facts, break their lies, and solve the case. The story doesn't unlock with keys or puzzles. It unlocks through what you can prove.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5030730/Seraphs_Kiss/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1906年，温彻斯特。阿拉贝拉·雷文克罗夫特命丧黄泉，九名嫌疑人被困于一座庄园宅邸之中。你将扮演哈特韦尔探长，将线索相互串联以铸就铁证、击碎众人的谎言，最终侦破此案。推动故事揭晓的并非钥匙或机关谜题，而是你所能证明的真相。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5030730/Seraphs_Kiss/]Steam[/url]]
